description: Figure 9 illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations, specifically by tag, with error bars representing standard deviations. The horizontal axis represents categories labeled “case,” “gender,” “tag,” “number,” and “tense,” listed in that order, while the vertical axis is labeled “effect” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5.  Five groups of bars are presented for each category, colored blue (mBERT-L₂), orange (mBERT-B₂), light orange (XML-R₂), and red (XML-B₂). Within each category, the bars are stacked, with mBERT-L₂ forming the base, followed by mBERT-B₂, XML-R₂, and XML-B₂ on top. For the “tag” category, the mBERT-L₂ bar is approximately 1.5 units tall, mBERT-B₂ is approximately 2.5 units tall, XML-R₂ is approximately 3 units tall, and XML-B₂ is approximately 4 units tall.  The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
